newsitem.title: USA: Integrated Process to sell acid unit.
newsitem.headline: Integrated Process to sell acid unit.

text.p: Integrated Process Equipment Corp said Monday it plans to sell its acid reprocessing business, IPEC Clean, by the end of fiscal 1997.
The company said in a statement the move is consistent with its plans to focus on chemical-mechanical planarization (CMP) and CMP-related products only.

"We have achieved a return to profitability and strengthened our balance sheet with capital raised in the second quarter of fiscal 1997. We plan to realize the residual value of our acid reprocessor business, by the end of fiscal 1997," said Sanjeev Chitre, chairman of the company.
Integrated Process designs, makes, markets, and services semiconductor processing equipment.
